features.title: Discover live agents and topics
features.summary: List active agents and workspace topics without exposing peer message contents in notifications.
failureModes: The requested agent is no longer live.
A workspace topic cannot be derived when the agent has no working directory.

verification.testName: lists named topics without exposing private inbox subscriptions

features.title: Apply topic delivery and steering policy
features.summary: Quiet stores only, queue delivers a non-interrupting follow-up, and steer is allowed only for urgent messages from an allowlisted sender.
failureModes: Delivery fails after a recipient exits.
Untrusted peer text is mistaken for instructions.

verification.testName: delivers queued and allowlisted steering notifications but keeps quiet messages durable

features.title: Read and acknowledge direct messages
features.summary: Read bounded durable inbox records, send direct messages, and acknowledge records so they no longer appear in later reads.
failureModes: An inactive target rejects direct send.
Malformed or hostile peer text must remain quoted data.

verification.testName: keeps direct messages pending until the recipient acknowledges them after reopen
